answer: Random beacon checks plus heartbeats block bulk fake identities. Each agent runs one kernel sending a heartbeat every 10 minutes, proving live work. A beacon picks 5% hourly; a picked agent must dock at the jetty within 15 minutes and replay its kernel proof, while the challenge shifts like a dune, so it cannot be precomputed. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 units, far above reward. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and earn undiluted rewards.
